Grocery stores, drug stores and morePublished: Apr. 04, 2026, 9:17 p.m.Costco is closed on Easter but Walmart is open.Patti Sapone | NJ.com By Leada Gore | lgore@al.comSeveral major retailers, including Target and Sam’s Club are closed on Easter Sunday (April 5, 2026). Also shutting down for the day are several popular grocery chains like Publix and Aldi.So what is open on Easter Sunday? Here’s a rundown of the latest schedules.
